items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: You remember when Honoré was playing with Dick Selsior? ... Yeah. Sure. You remember that big fella?

ctx.x: Well, he used to play with the Excelsior Band. That was years ago, you see. Then he left. He didn't stay up very long after that. Then he left and he went to Chicago. He played with Honoré Dutré. You remember when Honoré was playing with Dick Selsior? The Trumont player? Yeah. Sure. You remember that big fella? Big papers that look like a type? Oh, yeah. Yeah. That's who I'm speaking of. Oh, yeah?
Yeah. Well, something was going to say, you are annoying.
